newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Pearson seeks stake in S.African papers.
newsitem.headline: Pearson seeks stake in S.African papers.

text.p: Britain's Pearson Plc, publisher of the Financial Times, said on Monday it was negotiating to buy a stake in two leading South African newspapers, Business Day and the weekly Financial Mail.

Pearson and the papers' owner, Times Media Ltd, said in a joint statement they were "involved in negotiations regarding the possible acquisition by Pearson of an interest in Business Day and Financial Mail".
The announcement followed months of speculation that the British media group was eyeing the South African publications.
Industry sources said last week that talks between TML and Pearson were well advanced with the two companies planning to parcel off TML's business publications into a new jointly controlled company.
The move follows a deal last month which saw control of TML pass to a grouping of black business interests which bought 35 percent of Johnnies Industrial Corporation, which in turn controls TML.
